transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before I sign off on the annex room assignments and the controls for the equipment-issue desk and the protected medical-records desk, I need to hear from facilities and signal. Are there any room, infrastructure, or opening requirements we need to address before we open either desk? Both the East and West rooms can be made ready tomorrow morning, so let's get any issues on the table now.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Col. Mercer, I need to flag a floor-load concern before we finalize room assignments. The equipment-issue desk's steel storage cabinet weighs 1,100 kilograms when stocked. I verified this morning that East Room is rated for 800 kilograms and West Room is rated for 1,500 kilograms. That means the equipment-issue desk cannot safely go in East Room — it needs to go in West Room. I should note the floor-load figures haven't been added to the relocation worksheet yet, but the measurements are confirmed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Col. Mercer, I have a critical infrastructure requirement for the protected medical-records desk. That desk can only connect to the required isolated network through the fiber patch panel located in the East Room. My signal technician is already booked to certify that connection tomorrow from 0900 to 1000 — I received the confirmation this morning. However, this booking has not yet been added to the annex opening checklist, so we need to get it on there. This means the protected medical-records desk needs to go in East Room, which actually aligns with Maj. Alvarez's floor-load concern putting the equipment-issue desk in West Room.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Add the confirmed floor-load figures (East Room 800 kg, West Room 1,500 kg) to the relocation worksheet.
Add the signal technician's fiber certification booking (0900-1000 tomorrow) to the annex opening checklist.
